$comment: Multi-form-ready; v1 ships the single migrated CCAR-P form.

notes.method: Convergent concepts (tested by both source readings) were seated first, then adjusted by hand so the paper keeps the classic, high-frequency exam concepts alongside the recap-only concepts the reference practice set never covers.
recap_only_concepts_kept_on_the_exam: C-004 five factors, tightest constraint decides (1.04)
C-007 never retrieval as a substitute for live state (1.07)
C-016 Sonnet as the default tier (2.01)
C-033 five entry points and their trade-offs (3.07)
C-041 retries, fallback chains, circuit breakers (3.15)
C-043 eval suite written before production code (4.01)
C-056 safety as layers, the silent failure (5.01)
C-067 obligation to control to owner to evidence (5.12)
C-069 preference into constraint, requirement rows (6.02)
C-071 four AI properties and the three verdict forms (6.04)
C-075 signals to triggers to owners (6.08)
notes.reserve_rationale: The 22 reserve items are substitutes rather than rejects. Most sit in a concept cluster the exam already samples (three model-choice items, five prompting items, four retrieval-mechanics items), so any one can replace its neighbour without disturbing the format mix.
